text:
BOTDEFENSE::intent
Description
Returns the intent found for the bot that sent the current request.
The intent is based on the micro-service anomaly found for that
client and may have been detected in a previous request of the
client, not necessarily the present request
Syntax
BOTDEFENSE
::
intent
Examples
when
BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
{
if
{[
BOTDEFENSE
::
intent
]
contains
"OAT"
}
{
BOTDEFENSE
::
action
block
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
BOTDEFENSE_ACTION
Introduced: BIGIP-14.1.0
